title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Dealing with Unrepresented Parties
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: An unrepresented defendant in a Small Claims matter calls the plaintiff's paralegal to ask what happens if they sign a proposed consent order. How should the paralegal handle this conversation?
options: Refuse to speak to them at all and hang up the phone.
Explain exactly how the law applies to the defendant's specific situation.
Advise the defendant that the paralegal only represents the plaintiff, their interests are opposed, and urge the defendant to obtain independent legal advice.
Advise the defendant to sign the consent order because it is in their best interest.
questions.explain: Rule 4.05 requires that when dealing with unrepresented persons, the paralegal must take care to see the person is not proceeding under an illusion that their interests are being protected by the paralegal, must make clear who the paralegal represents, and must advise the person to obtain independent legal representation.
